# ECN-2026-039 - Change notice - Hot Forge induction billet heater #2

Revision: Rev E  
Plant: P2, line P2-L1  
Equipment: EQ-P2-L1-IH02

Reason for change
The coil cooling water flow minimum for Hot Forge induction billet heater #2 (EQ-P2-L1-IH02) is 55 L/min. This ECN establishes the minimum flow requirement as a controlled parameter for heater operation and maintenance. The change clarifies acceptance criteria for maintenance checks and process support documentation to reduce thermal stress on the coil assembly and improve heater reliability and life.

Affected items
- Equipment EQ-P2-L1-IH02 physical installation and associated cooling system monitoring.  
- Maintenance documentation MM-P2-L1-IH02 to reflect the verified minimum flow requirement and associated acceptance steps.  
- Operational procedure references in SOP-P2-L1-04 to include the minimum flow as an operational limit for safe heater start and run conditions.  
- Quality procedure QS-PROC-06 to include the minimum flow in inspection and audit checklists where applicable.

Implementation
- Update MM-P2-L1-IH02 to include a recorded verification step that documents measured flow equals or exceeds the specified minimum.  
- Revise SOP-P2-L1-04 to include a pre-start verification step that confirms coil cooling flow meets the minimum requirement and to define response actions if the requirement is not met.  
- Amend QS-PROC-06 to incorporate the minimum flow into periodic verification and audit criteria for induction heater cooling system integrity.  
- Field execution will be coordinated with maintenance and operations to perform initial verification and to place updated documents at points of use. All changes will be implemented in documentation and training prior to routine application.

Approvals
Prepared by: Maintenance Engineering (references: MM-P2-L1-IH02)  
Reviewed per quality process: QS-PROC-06  
Implemented per operations procedure: SOP-P2-L1-04

Signatures on file in document control.
